regional_summary_6h.headline: MENA threat index 2.11 (STABLE, steady) driven by Iran tensions

bullets.text: Iran's ongoing military conflict with the US and its allies is a major contributor to the region's stability concerns
Iran's involvement in regional proxy wars, including in Syria and Yemen, is exacerbating diplomatic tensions and humanitarian crises
The US-Iran conflict has significant implications for regional trade agreements and economic stability, with potential consequences for countries like Saudi Arabia and the UAE

markets.headline: Index forecast easing; Brent -0.1%; gold -0.1%; VIX -0.7% (model estimate).
markets.method_note: Threat beta = OLS of daily log-returns on the index change at the lead lag; launch-day estimates lean on BNTI-seeded history. Association, not causation.
